purpose: Proposed CSV import contract for invented demonstration floorplans; does not change existing migrations.
disclosure: SYNTHETIC DEMO LAYOUT — invented rooms and routes fitted to a supplied building silhouette. Not a verified campus floorplan; not for navigation or emergency use.
database_observation: 02_buildings.sql defines buildings(id UUID, buildings varchar(50) unique). No floor/room tables exist. Its trailing comma is an existing SQL syntax issue; this proposal leaves migrations unchanged.

identity.building_id: Immutable ASCII slug assigned once per source building; never derive it again from a renamed display name. Map to an existing buildings.id UUID through a separate import mapping rather than replacing database IDs.
identity.room_id: {floor_id}:r:{percent_encoded_number}; room number is a case-sensitive string and preserves leading zeroes/suffixes.
identity.core_id: {building_id}:core:{stable_token}; shared by the same stair/elevator on all four floors.
identity.explicit_spec_ids: Optional floor_id/room_id/id fields must be globally unique when supplied. Otherwise the validator derives canonical IDs. Duplicate visible numbers within one floor are invalid even across corridors and rooms.

csv_format.numbers: Room/corridor labels must be imported as text, never inferred as numeric.

columns.source_provenance: attachment/source identifier, attribution and extraction method

columns.name: exactly Floor 0, Floor 1, Floor 2, or Floor 3

columns.type: invented demo use, e.g. room, classroom, office, stairs, elevator
columns.core_id: required for a stair/elevator repeated across floors

corridors.csv.status: recommended companion table; do not treat corridors as real rooms

columns.number: exact visible corridor label such as 100C1

spec_contract.floor_naming: Exactly four floors with integer indices 0..3; recommend name='Floor '+index. No basement/ground/first-floor interpretation is implied.

coordinates.canvas: Original uncropped, unrotated source image canvas, including all margins; top-left origin, x right, y down.
coordinates.range: Inclusive 0..1000 on both axes, independently normalized. Original canvas aspect ratio must be preserved in output images.
coordinates.mapping: pixel_x=x/1000*(width-1); pixel_y=y/1000*(height-1). Raster checks round to nearest pixel.
coordinates.geometry: A simple, non-self-intersecting polygon or positive-area axis-aligned rect. Labels must lie in their own geometry. Doors must lie on their own boundary and inside the footprint. Shared walls are allowed; overlapping room interiors are not.
coordinates.mask: Exact binary silhouette supplied by extraction, with nonzero pixels inside. Default reads luminance (white inside); transparent cutouts may explicitly set source_mask_channel='alpha'. Never infer footprint from reference floorplan colors. Mask and original canvas dimensions must match.
coordinates.raster_tolerance: One pixel of room boundary is excluded for interior overlap checks. Corridor union uses four-neighbor connectivity after footprint clipping; gaps are reported. Footprint uncovered fraction counts mask pixels covered by neither rooms nor corridors. Label checks test anchor points, not font extents.

image_relationships.rule: Each floor row identifies exactly one rendered image and its spec floor. Every room/corridor row corresponds to exactly one visible label equal to number on that image; no free-floating extra room labels.
image_relationships.render: Navy filled interiors, fine pale blue/white walls, white labels, cyan stairs. Clip all geometry and labels to the exact source mask. Labels clipped away indicate failed data, not permission to omit them.
image_relationships.disclosure_placement: Store disclosure in metadata and show it next to the floor selector/image in the consuming UI. Do not add room-use, capacity, accessibility, egress or real-campus-location claims from invented geometry.
image_relationships.provenance: Keep silhouette source and style reference sources separate. The four attached floorplan photographs are style references, not evidence that invented rooms exist. Retain source filename, SHA-256, original canvas size, mask hash, extraction method, spec hash, generator version and render hash.

checks: String labels with no duplicates per floor
Nonzero room geometry and simple polygons
Label anchors in their own geometry
Doors on room boundary with N/S/E/W side
Room labels/doors inside exact supplied mask
Stable stair/elevator core centers and extents across floors
Corridor union connectivity and room-door access
Uncovered footprint pixel count and fraction
validation.missing_mask: Report exact-footprint checks as skipped with a warning; do not claim they passed.
validation.limitations: Raster checks are finite-resolution evidence, not a navigation or life-safety certification. Rendered label text equality and image hashes require a later export/render audit.
